# Agent instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before you change this repository.
Use the canonical skill files in `.github/skills/`.
Do not copy the skill text to another location.

Use ASD-STE100 Issue 9 as the reference for technical writing.
Keep the official dictionary outside this public repository.
Run the applicable tests and state the review limits.
Do not claim complete compliance from automated checks alone.
